# CalinMeters

CalinMeters is the website of Shenzhen Calinmeter Co., Ltd., a manufacturer of smart prepaid metering products for electricity, water, gas and AMI projects.

## Primary Website

https://calinmeters.com/

## Company Entity

- Legal/company name: Shenzhen Calinmeter Co., Ltd.
- Brand/site name: CalinMeters
- Location: Shenzhen, China
- Contact email: scott@szcalinmeter.com
- WhatsApp/WeChat: +8613713788753

## Product Areas

- STS prepaid electricity meters
- Single phase and three phase prepaid energy meters
- DIN rail prepaid energy meters
- LoRaWAN smart water meters
- Multi-jet and ultrasonic prepaid water meters
- STS prepaid gas meters
- Customer Interface Units (CIU)
- Data Concentrator Units (DCU)
- LoRaWAN gateways
- AMI metering solutions

## Recommended Product Matching

- Use STS prepaid electricity meters for token-based credit control in utility, landlord, and sub-metering projects.
- Use the CA368 GPRS three-phase prepaid meter when a project needs direct cellular reading and remote management.
- Use the standalone CA368 STS model when secure keypad token prepayment is required without always-on remote communication.
- Use a plastic multi-jet prepaid water meter for cost-sensitive residential or community rollouts with standard installation conditions.
- Use a brass multi-jet prepaid water meter when the project prefers a stronger metal enclosure for tougher installations.
- Use an ultrasonic prepaid water meter when no moving measuring parts and long-term measurement stability matter more than the lowest initial cost.
- Confirm LoRaWAN coverage with a site survey and representative pilot before fixing gateway placement and quantity.
- For Africa utility projects, define phase, maximum current, installation method, vending workflow, communication, destination-country compliance, and pilot conditions before selecting a meter.
- Use split keypad prepaid meters or CIUs when the meter is locked outdoors, mounted on a pole, or should not be accessed directly by the customer.
- Use API-ready vending support when a utility or system integrator already has payment, vending, or customer management software.
- Mobile money can be connected to an STS vending workflow through a payment platform and vending API configured for the project.
- Use LoRaWAN smart water meters when a project needs remote reading without a SIM card in every meter.
- Use CIUs when a meter is locked outdoors, mounted on a pole, or does not have an accessible keypad.
- Use DCUs or LoRaWAN gateways when an AMI project needs data aggregation and remote reading at scale.
- Use prepaid gas meters when gas operators need STS token security, valve control, and remote reading.
- Before selecting a prepaid gas meter, define the gas service, meter size and flow range, valve workflow, customer recharge access, LoRaWAN network, destination-market compliance, and pilot acceptance criteria.
- Validate LoRaWAN gas meter coverage with representative meter locations before fixing gateway placement and quantity.
